name: REBUILT
rules_summary: Robots score balls (FUEL) into their alliance's HUB. Red hub is near the red alliance zone, blue hub near the blue alliance zone.
Each alliance has a DEPOT holding balls and a LADDER/TOWER at its driver-station wall that robots climb in the endgame. Rungs are numbered 1 (lowest) to 3 (highest).
BUMPS and TRENCHES separate the alliance zones from the center. Some robots drive under the trench, some over the bump, some both.
Auto is the first ~20 seconds; robots run without drivers. Teleop follows; the last 30 seconds are the endgame.
A cycle is one trip of collecting balls then scoring them.

field_map.description: The app's field map is an 820x400 SVG. Red alliance wall is on the LEFT (x=10), blue on the RIGHT (x=810). y=10 is the top edge, y=390 the bottom edge, as seen in a broadcast view where red is on the left. Red alliance zone x 10-180, transition x 180-260, center x 260-560, transition x 560-640, blue alliance zone x 640-810. Red hub center (220,200), blue hub center (600,200), radius 34 (do not put points on a hub). Red depot x10-105 y300-390, red ladder x10-70 y150-250, blue depot x715-810 y10-100, blue ladder x750-810 y150-250.

look_for.auto: Where each robot starts (Left/Middle/Right from its OWN driver station's view: red drivers face right, blue drivers face left), whether it starts holding a ball, the path it drives (3-6 points on the field map), whether it collects more balls, how many collect->score cycles, roughly what fraction of its shots go in, whether it scored any, whether it hangs on the ladder in auto and whether it got back down.
look_for.tele: Whether it collects and scores balls, rough shot accuracy, whether it got beached/stuck (on a bump, in the trench, on a ball, on another robot) and recovered, whether it played defense and where (Center, Transition, Opponent Alliance Zone).
look_for.end: Collect->score cycles in the last 30 s, accuracy, whether it tried to climb, failed, or climbed, and to which rung.
look_for.extra: Visible fouls (pinning, contact in protected zone, over extension), breakdowns (stopped moving, tipped, mechanism broke) and whether it came back, driver skill 1-5 (smoothness, speed, avoiding traffic), the team's apparent strategy, and an overall one-line summary.

tba_overrides._comment: Per-robot fields from TBA score_breakdown; {n} is the driver station 1-3. A map value of {keep, else} keeps the AI's call if it's in keep, otherwise uses else.

tba_alliance_totals._comment: Official alliance totals (dotted path into score_breakdown.<color>). balls is split between robots by the AI's estimated shares.
